 Bangladesh public holidays 2027: Cabinet approves 29 days
 Seven holidays coincide with Fridays and Saturdays 
 Published : 2 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 2 November 2026, 20:15
 • 
 GOVERNANCE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 The cabinet has approved 29 days of public holidays for 2027, comprising 15 days of general holidays and 14 days of holidays declared by executive order.
 However, since seven of these holidays fall on Fridays and Saturdays, government employees will enjoy a total of 22 days off.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman at the Secretariat this evening.
 Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Gani announced the decision at a press conference at the Secretariat following the meeting.
